description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Pipeline' that displays a sales pipeline with various stages. It manages state for columns (deals grouped by stage) and loading status, fetches pipeline data from an API upon mounting, and allows moving deals between stages with API calls. The component renders a grid of 'Card' components for each stage, showing deals and provide buttons for moving deals.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Async function that fetches pipeline data and organizes it into columns grouped by stage. Handles errors by resetting columns to empty.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Async function that updates the stage of a deal, calling API.moveDeal and updating the component state to reflect the move. It catches and ignores errors.
